faq.question: Will a new printhead fix it?
faq.answer: In about 70% of cases yes, but you must verify cartridges are not the root cause first.

title: Firmware Communication Error
shortDescription: A firmware error has occurred and the printer cannot continue.
fullDescription: Error 49.4C02 is a firmware exception triggered by corrupted print job data, network packet errors, or a firmware bug. The printer halts to prevent damage and requires a reset.

causes.cause: Bad network packet from PCL/PostScript driver

fixSteps.title: Power Cycle
fixSteps.instruction: Turn off, unplug for 60 seconds, plug back in and turn on.

fixSteps.title: Clear Print Queue
fixSteps.instruction: Open Devices and Printers, double-click printer, cancel all documents in queue.

fixSteps.title: Update Firmware
fixSteps.instruction: Download latest firmware from HP support site and install via USB or web interface.

fixSteps.title: Cold Reset
fixSteps.instruction: Turn off, hold checkmark/OK button while turning on, release after 'Permanent Storage Init' appears.

whenToCallPro: If error returns immediately after cold reset, the formatter board likely needs replacement by a technician.

faq.question: What does 49 mean?
faq.answer: It is HP's general firmware/communication error class.

faq.question: Will updating firmware void warranty?
faq.answer: No, firmware updates from HP are official and supported.

title: Paper Jam in Top Cover Area
shortDescription: Paper has jammed near the top cover of the printer.
fullDescription: Code 13.20.00 indicates the paper sensor near the top cover detected paper that did not progress through the fuser correctly. Common when printing thick stock or after a previous jam.

fixSteps.title: Open Top Cover
fixSteps.instruction: Open the top cover and carefully remove all visible paper, pulling in direction of travel.

fixSteps.title: Inspect for Torn Pieces
fixSteps.instruction: Use flashlight to check for small paper fragments inside fuser area.

fixSteps.title: Check Sensor Flag
fixSteps.instruction: Locate fuser delivery sensor flag, ensure it moves freely without obstruction.

fixSteps.title: Replace Fuser
fixSteps.instruction: If repeated jams continue, replace the fuser assembly (consumable part).

whenToCallPro: If sensor flag is broken or fuser is past its rated life cycle, professional service ensures correct calibration.

faq.question: Can I keep printing with this jam?
faq.answer: No, the printer locks out until paper path is clear.

title: Carriage Jam
shortDescription: The print carriage is stuck and cannot move freely.
fullDescription: Error 0xb83c0010 occurs when the printhead carriage encounters mechanical resistance. Caused by paper debris, foreign objects, broken encoder strip, or carriage belt issues.

causes.cause: Paper or foreign object blocking carriage

symptoms: Carriage stuck in middle or side
Print quality with vertical bands before failure

fixSteps.title: Power Off and Inspect
fixSteps.instruction: Turn off printer and open top cover. Manually slide carriage to check for obstructions.

fixSteps.title: Clean Encoder Strip
fixSteps.instruction: Wipe the thin clear plastic strip behind carriage with lint-free cloth and distilled water.

fixSteps.title: Lubricate Carriage Rod
fixSteps.instruction: Apply 2-3 drops of light machine oil along the carriage rod, move carriage left-right.

fixSteps.title: Check Belt Tension
fixSteps.instruction: Inspect drive belt for slack, broken teeth, or damage; replace if defective.

whenToCallPro: If belt or carriage motor needs replacement and you are not comfortable disassembling printer chassis, call a pro.

faq.question: Why does encoder strip matter?
faq.answer: It tells the printer the exact carriage position; even fingerprints can cause errors.

faq.question: Can I use WD-40?
faq.answer: No, use only light machine or sewing-machine oil. WD-40 attracts dust.

title: Transfer Alienation Failure
shortDescription: The transfer roller has failed to engage or disengage properly.
fullDescription: Error 59.F0 indicates the transfer alienation mechanism — the system that lifts the transfer belt from drums during non-printing — has failed. Common in color LaserJet printers after heavy use.

fixSteps.title: Power Cycle
fixSteps.instruction: Turn off printer for 60 seconds, then back on. May clear soft errors.

fixSteps.title: Reseat ITB
fixSteps.instruction: Open right door, remove and reseat the intermediate transfer belt assembly.

fixSteps.title: Inspect Alienation Gears
fixSteps.instruction: Remove rear panel and inspect gears connecting alienation motor to ITB lifter for stripped teeth.

fixSteps.title: Replace ITB Assembly
fixSteps.instruction: Order new ITB and replace if belt is damaged or mechanism is bent.

whenToCallPro: ITB replacement requires precise alignment; certified technicians ensure proper engagement of all gears and sensors.

faq.question: Is ITB the same as drum?
faq.answer: No, the ITB is a belt that transfers toner from drums to paper.

title: Cartridge Not Recognized
shortDescription: The printer cannot read the ink cartridge chip.
fullDescription: Error 0xc6fd0113 indicates the printer cannot communicate with one or more ink cartridges. Caused by dirty contacts, counterfeit cartridges, firmware lockouts, or bad cartridge chips.
symptoms: X mark on cartridge in display

fixSteps.title: Reseat Cartridge
fixSteps.instruction: Remove the indicated cartridge and reinsert firmly until it clicks.

fixSteps.title: Clean Contacts
fixSteps.instruction: Use lint-free cloth slightly dampened with distilled water to clean cartridge and printer contacts.

fixSteps.title: Try Genuine HP Cartridge
fixSteps.instruction: If using third-party ink, try a genuine HP cartridge to rule out firmware lockout.

fixSteps.title: Disable Firmware Update Check
fixSteps.instruction: From printer settings, disable automatic firmware updates if you intend to use third-party cartridges.

whenToCallPro: If contact assembly is physically damaged or firmware cannot be downgraded, technician service is needed.

faq.question: Why does HP block third-party ink?
faq.answer: HP claims quality and IP protection; users may downgrade firmware in some cases.

faq.question: Can I rollback firmware?
faq.answer: Sometimes, depending on model. Check HP support site or community forums.

title: Supply Memory Error
shortDescription: The printer cannot read the toner cartridge memory chip.
fullDescription: Code 10.00.00 indicates a failure in reading the e-label or memory tag on a toner cartridge. Caused by bad chip, dirty contacts, counterfeit cartridge, or contact reader failure.

fixSteps.title: Reseat Cartridge
fixSteps.instruction: Remove and reinsert the affected toner cartridge.

fixSteps.title: Clean Memory Tag
fixSteps.instruction: Wipe the small chip on the cartridge with a dry lint-free cloth.

fixSteps.title: Test with Different Cartridge
fixSteps.instruction: Swap with another known-good cartridge to isolate fault.

fixSteps.title: Replace E-Label Reader
fixSteps.instruction: Technician replaces reader assembly inside printer if multiple cartridges fail.

whenToCallPro: If cleaning and swapping cartridges does not resolve the error, the e-label reader inside the printer needs professional replacement.

faq.question: What is an e-label?
faq.answer: Electronic label/chip storing toner usage data, model, expiration.

faq.question: Can I bypass e-label?
faq.answer: Some cartridges include resettable chips; use at your own risk.

title: Scanner Failure
shortDescription: The flatbed scanner is not responding or has failed self-test.
fullDescription: Error 0xc05d0282 means the scanner subsystem failed during initialization or operation. Causes include locked scan bar, failed scanner motor, blown CCFL lamp, or cable disconnection.
symptoms: Scanner does not move on power-up

fixSteps.title: Check Scanner Lock
fixSteps.instruction: Verify any shipping lock on scanner is released (older models).

fixSteps.title: Power Cycle
fixSteps.instruction: Turn off, unplug for 60 seconds, restart.

fixSteps.title: Reseat Scanner Cable
fixSteps.instruction: Remove top scanner cover and reseat ribbon cable to formatter board.

fixSteps.title: Replace Scanner Assembly
fixSteps.instruction: If lamp or motor is dead, replace entire scanner unit.

whenToCallPro: If scanner motor or lamp has failed, replacing the assembly correctly requires technician experience to avoid damaging cables.

faq.question: Can I use the printer without scanner?
faq.answer: Most MFPs allow printing even with scanner error after dismissing.

title: Carriage Stall on Startup
shortDescription: The printer carriage failed to move during the boot sequence.
fullDescription: Error 0xc4eb8281 occurs when the carriage cannot home itself during printer startup. Often caused by paper trapped in the path, frozen carriage rod, or encoder fault.
symptoms: Printer beeps and shows error on power-up
Carriage does not move from parked position
Won't initialize even with no print job

fixSteps.title: Remove Visible Paper
fixSteps.instruction: Open access door, remove any paper or debris under or around carriage.

fixSteps.title: Clean Carriage Rod
fixSteps.instruction: Wipe the metal rod with dry cloth to remove dust or dried ink.

fixSteps.title: Lubricate Rod
fixSteps.instruction: Apply small amount of light oil along rod, move carriage manually.

fixSteps.title: Check Encoder
fixSteps.instruction: Inspect transparent encoder strip for cracks, ink, or fingerprints.

whenToCallPro: If motor is dead or encoder strip is broken, professional replacement is recommended to avoid damaging delicate parts.

faq.question: Is it safe to power off mid-jam?
faq.answer: Yes, but always remove paper before powering on again.

title: Scanner Calibration Failed
shortDescription: The scanner failed its calibration routine on startup.
fullDescription: Error 30.01.01 indicates the scanner could not properly calibrate the white reference strip. Caused by dirty calibration strip, ADF issues, or scanner cable problems.
symptoms: Scans show streaks or wrong colors

fixSteps.title: Clean Calibration Strip
fixSteps.instruction: Open ADF and clean the thin white plastic strip with damp lint-free cloth.

fixSteps.title: Clean Glass
fixSteps.instruction: Wipe scanner glass and ADF glass with non-abrasive glass cleaner.

fixSteps.title: Reseat ADF Cable
fixSteps.instruction: Open ADF cover, locate ribbon cable, reseat firmly.

fixSteps.title: Run Diagnostic Reset
fixSteps.instruction: From service menu, run scanner calibration reset.

whenToCallPro: If scanner unit hardware has failed, replacement requires service technician.

faq.question: Where is the calibration strip?
faq.answer: Usually a white plastic strip on the underside of ADF, parallel to the scanner glass.
